description.zh: 安静了设定的时长后，应用叫醒 Coo 的一条作息提示：开不开口、做什么由 Coo 自己决定。
description.en: After the configured quiet time the app wakes the bot with a rhythm line; whether to speak or act is the bot's own call.

description.zh: 睡眠时段给 Coo 的提示：入睡（该睡了）、醒来（该醒了），以及被吵醒时的兜底提示。文案可在 data/rhythm/messages.json 里改。
description.en: Sleep-window lines for the bot: bedtime, wake-up, and a best-effort "you were woken" hint. Wording lives in data/rhythm/messages.json.

description.zh: 睡眠时段里被人打扰时留档的一条记录（只入库、不投递），供其他插件按时间轴读取「被吵醒」事件。
description.en: An archived record of a person waking the bot during its sleep window (stored, never delivered) so other plugins can read the wake-ups.
